name: CaseGridZeroTrackCollapse
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-zero-track-collapse" (grid-tracks). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a computed grid track list containing a 0px track — the resolved width of an EMPTY slot column (min-content with no occupant)
